entities.summary: Dragan Lukovski is a Macedonian-born Serbian retired professional basketball player, who played as a point guard. He is 1.91 m tall and weighs 85 kg. Dragan and his father, Janko Lukovski, former coach, are now owners of basketball club Sport Key in Novi Sad (Serbia).
